name: Minor Healing Draught
flavor: Tastes like copper and regret. Works anyway.

name: Greater Healing Draught
flavor: The good stuff. Don't ask what's floating in it.

name: Battle Tonic
flavor: Bottled adrenaline. Legal in most jurisdictions.

name: Iron Skin Elixir
flavor: Your skin doesn't turn to iron. It just feels like it does.

name: Healing Tonic
flavor: Charcoal and droppings. It works, somehow. Don't ask.

name: Smelly Bomb
flavor: The smell alone lowers its guard.

name: Painkiller Colada
flavor: Coconut cream, pineapple juice, and just enough dark rum to make the wounds feel like someone else's problem.

name: Zombie's Revenge
flavor: Five rums, one grudge, zero survivors. Hits harder than it should. So do you, right up until you trip over your own feet.

name: Blue Hawaiian Haze
flavor: Blue curacao and rum, served with a little umbrella that does absolutely nothing. Somehow, neither do incoming attacks.

name: A bag of mystery powder
flavor: You saw some goblin's eating this candy with their noses... how strange...
